business_problem: Before Databricks, Cafe24 struggled with fragmented systems, inconsistent KPIs and slow, manual data processes that limited automation and made it difficult to apply AI at scale.
solution_summary: Cafe24 is the number one online shopping mall platform in Korea, supporting more than 2 million brands as they build, operate and scale their businesses globally. At the scale of Cafe24, data sits at the center of commerce innovation. Trillions of won in transactions and hundreds of gigabytes of data generated daily create both opportunity and complexity for AI-driven growth. Before Databricks, Cafe24 struggled with fragmented systems, inconsistent KPIs and slow, manual data processes that limited automation and made it difficult to apply AI at scale. After unifying data on Databricks, Cafe24 connected analytics directly to execution, standardizing insights, enabling autonomous workflows and turning operations into a continuous learning loop.
business_outcome: Cafe24 achieved measurable business impact on Databricks, including 64% Increase in average order value for Cafe24 (supported by Databricks) users; 36% Increase in new customers for Cafe24 users; <5 minutes Time spent doing marketplace operations work (reduced from 3 hours).
